name: Unified Editorial Operating System

workflow.name: Tayoca Growth OS | Demand Engine & Revenue Command Center

tests.evidence: Selector intentionally failed closed with 'No safe review-required editorial opportunity is eligible for drafting'; no downstream drafting or publication nodes executed.
Rejected opportunity was marked rejected/blocked_rejected and the drafting guard emitted zero items before the model.
Correction created r2, reset approval, cleared inherited campaign state, superseded the original, and marked the correction applied.
PDF report build, file conversion, KPI branch, and Slack delivery path executed successfully under pin testing.

tests.gate: approved public opportunity model and format routing
tests.evidence: The live OpenRouter/free model returned parsed JSON with primary format technical_article and all five required channel adaptations. The test exposed that the downstream parser expected a string; the parser was changed to accept parsed objects or JSON strings.

The exact successful model-output shape produced six assets: editorial_primary, linkedin, instagram, tiktok, youtube, and paid_social. All retained opportunity/evidence/disclosure/CTA/approval traceability; budget remained zero.

provider_availability.observed_issue: Subsequent integrated positive retries after the parser fix returned intermittent upstream/test 502 Bad Gateway without an n8n execution ID.
provider_availability.impact: Generation fails closed: campaign/content rows are not created, nothing is published, and paid spend is not released.
provider_availability.certification_basis: The same model path successfully returned the required Stage 8 object in execution 68865, and that exact output shape passed the corrected deterministic packer. The later 502 is recorded as an external availability limitation rather than concealed or bypassed with a paid provider.

rollback.ledger: Stage 8 tabs and added traceability columns may remain safely because the rollback workflow does not consume them. Remove them only for a full data-plane rollback before real editorial history is accumulated.
rollback.history_safety: After real corrections or approvals exist, do not delete Editorial Opportunities/Editorial Corrections history during rollback.

limitations: OpenRouter/free was intermittently unavailable with 502 responses during final integrated positive retries.
No paid provider fallback was introduced.
Stage 8 marks approved packages ready for controlled distribution; it does not itself implement Stage 9 distribution/publishing automation.
